description: Connect ChatGPT to your Invertironline brokerage account and trade Argentine markets directly in conversation. Pull real-time quotes and order books for stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, and options on BYMA, with full options chains including Greeks. Place buy and sell orders, set stop loss and take profit levels, and subscribe to or redeem mutual funds (FCI). Review your portfolio holdings, cash balance across settlement terms, and recent account activity. Every order is validated before submission, so you always confirm the price, commissions, and any sworn declarations required before anything is executed.
